data.one_liner: Collection of 36 production-ready Flutter hooks inspired by react-use.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of Flutter hooks for async operations, form management, UI interactions, state management, and device sensors. It aims to simplify common lifecycle and state logic in flutter_hooks-based applications.
use_when: You are using flutter_hooks in your project and need common hooks for async, forms, or UI state.
You want to manage timers, debounces, or throttling declaratively inside widgets.
You need modular hooks for accessing device info, sensors, or media.
avoid_when: Your project does not use flutter_hooks.
You prefer traditional StatefulWidget or ChangeNotifier approaches for state management.
strengths: Includes form management and validation out of the box.
Modular companion packages available for specific device features and sensors.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the flutter_hooks ecosystem.
Some platform features require additional setup of underlying third-party plugins.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_use and flutter_hooks to your pubspec.yaml. Specialized packages like flutter_use_audio or flutter_use_geolocation require their respective underlying packages (e.g., just_audio, geolocator).
